verses.1: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.2: “Son of man, pose a riddle; speak a parable to the house of Israel
verses.3:
and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says:
 ‘A great eagle with great wings and long pinions, + 17:3 Pinions are the outer parts of a bird’s wings, including the flight feathers. 
 full of feathers of many colors,
 came to Lebanon
 and took away the top of the cedar.
verses.4:
He plucked off its topmost shoot,
 carried it to the land of merchants,
 and planted it in a city of traders.
verses.5:
He took some of the seed of the land
 and planted it in fertile soil; + 17:5 Hebrew in a field of seed 
 he placed it by abundant waters
 and set it out like a willow.
verses.6:
It sprouted and became a spreading vine,
 low in height, with branches turned toward him;
 yet its roots remained where it stood.
 So it became a vine and yielded branches
 and sent out shoots.
verses.7:
But there was another great eagle
 with great wings and many feathers.
 And behold, this vine bent its roots toward him.
 It stretched out its branches to him from its planting bed,
 so that he might water it.
verses.8:
It had been planted in good soil
 by abundant waters
 in order to yield branches and bear fruit
 and become a splendid vine.’
verses.9:
So you are to tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says:
 ‘Will it flourish?
 Will it not be uprooted and stripped of its fruit
 so that it shrivels?
 All its foliage will wither!
 It will not take a strong arm or many people
 to pull it up by its roots.
verses.10:
Even if it is transplanted,
 will it flourish?
 Will it not completely wither when the east wind strikes?
 It will wither on the bed where it sprouted.’”
 The Parable Explained
verses.11: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.12:
“Now say to this rebellious house: ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’
 Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, carried off its king and officials, and brought them back with him to Babylon.
verses.13: He took a member of the royal family + 17:13 Hebrew the royal seed and made a covenant with him, putting him under oath. Then he carried away the leading men of the land,
verses.14: so that the kingdom would be brought low, unable to lift itself up, surviving only by keeping his covenant.
verses.15: But this king rebelled against Babylon by sending his envoys to Egypt to ask for horses and a large army. Will he flourish? Will the one who does such things escape? Can he break a covenant and yet escape?’
verses.16: ‘As surely as I live,’ declares the Lord GOD, ‘he will die in Babylon, in the land of the king who enthroned him, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke.
verses.17: Pharaoh with his mighty army and vast horde will not help him in battle, when ramps are built and siege walls constructed to destroy many lives.
verses.18: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Seeing that he gave his hand in pledge yet did all these things, he will not escape!’
verses.19: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, I will bring down upon his head My oath that he despised and My covenant that he broke.
verses.20: I will spread My net over him and catch him in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment upon him there for the treason he committed against Me.
verses.21: All his choice troops + 17:21 Many Hebrew manuscripts; MT All his fleeing troops will fall by the sword, and those who survive will be scattered to every wind. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.’
verses.22:
This is what the Lord GOD says:
 ‘I will take a shoot from the lofty top of the cedar,
 and I will set it out.
 I will pluck a tender sprig from its topmost shoots,
 and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
verses.23:
I will plant it on the mountain heights of Israel
 so that it will bear branches;
 it will yield fruit
 and become a majestic cedar.
 Birds of every kind will nest under it,
 taking shelter in the shade of its branches.
verses.24:
Then all the trees of the field will know
 that I am the LORD.
 I bring the tall tree down
 and make the low tree tall.
 I dry up the green tree
 and make the withered tree flourish.
 I, the LORD, have spoken,
 and I have done it.’”
